description: Evidence record for the v4 upload: what was submitted, what it played, and what it scored. The repository's working agent.py is a later engine and is not the subject of any result here.

submission.label: 0609v4
submission.verified_by: zipfile member digest and an extraction into a temporary directory outside the repository; the archive was not modified
submission.change_from_previous: time allocation: the constant 3.0 s per-move ceiling was removed from the budget expression, leaving available / 32 and the clock reserve

attribution_evidence: The leaderboard snapshot of 2026-09-07 records KilliManjaru1 at 28 games with a 11-3-14 record. Rounds 29-53 from the platform CSV total 10-3-12; adding round 54 (Win), 55 (Loss) and 56 (Loss) reproduces 11-3-14 over 28 games exactly.

Clock signature. This submission removed the 3.0 s per-move ceiling, so its budget ceiling is about 3.75 s. Rounds 44-53 show a slowest move of 3.50-3.60 s; rounds 54, 55 and 56 show 3.515, 3.522 and 3.602 s, with 8, 7 and 5 moves above 2.95 s. The previous build could not exceed 2.9 s in any of rounds 29-43, so these three games cannot have been played by it.
No newer submission directory or archive exists in the repository.

results_csv.note: The CSV is the platform's cumulative export and contains rounds 29 through 53 only. Rounds 29-43 were played by earlier submissions and must not be attributed to this one. Rounds 54, 55 and 56 were downloaded as PGNs before a refreshed CSV existed, so no CSV row backs them; every *_matches_csv check is recorded as null for those three rather than asserted, and attribution rests on rated_rounds.attribution_evidence.

working_agent.note: Newer than the submission: the submitted source plus the accepted quiescence delta-pruning change. It played none of rounds 44 through 53, so no result in this file is evidence about it.

rejected_candidates.896ac0b24e5e7961ea5927e40f188163af4136e3: tactical check extension; failed verify.py and reduced completed depth. Not revived.

game_files_note: The ten PGNs are byte-identical copies of the platform downloads that also sit at the top of this directory. *.pgn is ignored repository-wide; .gitignore carries one narrow exception, !submission*/games/*.pgn, so this evidence directory is tracked while every other PGN stays ignored. .gitattributes marks the same paths -text so core.autocrlf cannot rewrite them and invalidate the digests above.
